case: Six nested PostgreSQL domains over a custom enum
contract: Catalog metadata resolves the six-domain column to the schema-qualified enum leaf.
A schema-aware keyed edit preserves the six-layer outer domain type.
Draft inserts preserve an enum label and SQL NULL as the six-layer outer domain type.
A typed equality filter selects the edited row with the exact outer pg_typeof value.
An invalid enum label is rejected with SQLSTATE 22P02 and does not mutate the stored row.
Independent native value/type queries confirm the exact values, outer domain type, and unchanged SQL NULL sibling.

focused.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration domain_contract::value_contract_six_domain_levels_over_enum_preserve_metadata_keyed_and_draft_values -- --include-ignored --exact --test-threads=1

domain_contract_group.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration domain_contract:: -- --include-ignored --test-threads=1

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres --all-targets -- -D warnings

remaining: Domain chains deeper than six layers and other enum/session configurations remain untested.
This case does not close the broader B3 engine/type/consumer/configuration matrix.
